title: An integer multiplicity current in U plus the restriction of one in ℝ^P (parent step 3, construction of Z)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be integer multiplicity and let Y ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be integer multiplicity. Then there is an integer multiplicity Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with Z(ω) = T(ω) + Y(ιω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Here ιω = testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω is ω regarded as a test form in ℝ^P (same underlying form).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → ∃ Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsIntegerMultiplicity Z ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = T ω + Y (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω)
